# Aggregation and Common Pattern Errors and Warnings

Messages of the COM family, reported by PostSharp.Patterns.Aggregation and the common patterns: [Aggregatable], [Child], [Reference] and [Parent], and the advisable collections.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:com001?text=COM001> | Error | A field or property is marked with more than one of [Child], [Reference] and [Parent]. |
| <xref:com002?text=COM002> | Error | A field or property of an aggregatable class does not say whether it holds a child, a reference or the parent. |
| <xref:com003?text=COM003> | Error | A [Child], [Reference] or [Parent] attribute is applied to a property that is not automatic. |
| <xref:com004?text=COM004> | Error | A [Child], [Reference] or [Parent] attribute is applied to a member whose type cannot have a relationship. |
| <xref:com007?text=COM007> | Error | The IsParentSurrogate property of a [Child] attribute is not valid for the type of the field or property. |
| <xref:com008?text=COM008> | Error | A child field or property uses a standard collection type instead of an advisable collection. |
| <xref:com009?text=COM009> | Error | A child field or automatic property of a struct type is read-only. |
| <xref:com010?text=COM010> | Error | A range contract is applied to a numeric type that cannot hold any value of the range. |
| <xref:com011?text=COM011> | Error | An async lambda or anonymous method opens a custom logging activity. |
| <xref:com012?text=COM012> | Warning | A relationship attribute is applied to a static field or property, and PostSharp ignores it. |
| <xref:com013?text=COM013> | Warning | A [Child], [Parent] or [Reference] attribute is applied in a class that does not have the [Aggregatable] aspect. |
| <xref:com014?text=COM014> | Warning | A collection field or property of a class with a threading model has neither [Child] nor [Reference]. |
| <xref:com015?text=COM015> | Warning | A relationship attribute applied with the field: target to an automatic property has no effect. |
| <xref:com016?text=COM016> | Warning | A read-only automatic property has [Reference] on its backing field but not on the property. |
| <xref:com017?text=COM017> | Warning | An automatic property and its backing field have different relationship attributes. |
| <xref:com018?text=COM018> | Warning | A relationship attribute is applied to the backing field of a string, delegate or value-type property. |
